name: Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 05, 2016 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy from Lomita Station
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting on March 8, 2016 and the Regular Meeting held on March 15, 2016
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2016-11 Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for Parks and Recreation Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
February 2016 Treasurer's Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Approval of an agreement with South Bay Workforce Investment Board (SBWIB) for the Worksite Experience Program.
ACTION: That the City Manager be authorized to sign the Worksite Agency Agreement between the City of Lomita and SBWIB.
Item #7j
k.
Notice of Completion for Oak Street Water Main Replacement and Pavement Reconstruction Project
ACTION: 1) Accept the work performed by Palp, Inc. dba Excel Paving Company, for the Oak Street Water Main Replacement and Pavement Reconstruction Project; and
2)
Authorize the Director of Public Works to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $94,420.41 to Palp, Inc. dba Excel Paving Company, 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond; and
3)
Authorize the City Clerk to file the attached NOC with the County Recorder's Office.
Item #7k
l.
Approval of Final Map for Tract No. 26076
ACTION: Approve Final Map for Tract No. 26076 (located at 25048 & 25102 Narbonne Avenue and 25047 and 25043 Woodward Avenue), as recommended by the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Works.
Item #7l
m.
Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with Emergency Planning Consultants to provide Consultant Services Related to the Update of the Local Hazard Mitigation Plan and Emergency Operations Plan
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Emergency Planning Consultants for consultant services related to the update of the Local Hazard Mitigation Plan and Emergency Operations Plan in an amount not to exceed $30,000.
Item #7m
n.
Adopt Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) regarding the administration and cost sharing for implementing the Coordinated Integrated Monitoring Program (CIMP) for the Dominguez Channel Watershed Management Plan
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council take the following action:
1)
Approve a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) regarding the administration and cost sharing for implementing the Coordinated Integrated Monitoring Program (CIMP) for the Dominguez Watershed Management Area; and
2)
Authorize the Mayor to sign the MOA; and
3)
Approve Lomita's estimated share of the funding amount shown in Exhibit A of the MOA, totaling $183,960 for Fiscal Years 2015-16, 2016-17 and 2017-18.
Item #7n
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF A CONSTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION ORDINANCE
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Ord. 799- An ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita establishing a new Chapter 5 of Title V of the Lomita Municipal Code - Construction and Demolition Waste Management.
ACTION: After conducting the public hearing, and after City Attorney reads the title of the ordinance, the City Council shall:
(1) Introduce on first reading an ordinance establishing Chapter 5 of Title V, Construction and Demolition Waste Management.; and
(2) Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the April 19, 2016, City Council meeting.
Item #8
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF AN ONLINE PERMITTING PROGRAM
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to: 1) Enter into an agreement with ViewPoint
Government Solutions, Inc. (ViewPoint) to provide permitting software set-up, training, implementation for a one-time fee of $3,000; and 2) enter into an agreement for annual licensing and maintenance renewed on a yearly basis at a cost of $6,000.
Item #9
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, April 19, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
